'''Denaria Kee''' was a [[Koorivar]] [[Gender|female]] who served as personal assistant and [[Chief Aide/Canon|Chief Aide]] to [[Passel Argente]], [[Magistrate]] of the [[Corporate Alliance]]. In [[22 BBY]], the pair attended a [[Geonosian accord|secret summit]] on the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]] where Argente and other corporate leaders pledged themselves to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist cause]] of [[Count]] [[Dooku]]. The [[Galactic Republic]] attacked them on Geonosis soon after, starting the [[Clone Wars]].

In [[19 BBY]], Kee accompanied Argente when he and the rest of the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist Council]] were sent to the planet [[Mustafar]]. Kee was present when the Separatist leader [[Darth Sidious]] then contacted the council and told them to await his [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. When Vader arrived he attacked the council on Sidious's orders, [[Death|stabbing]] Kee through the chest with his [[Skywalker lightsaber|lightsaber]] shortly before he killed Argente.

==Biography==
===Argente's aide===
[[Homeworld|Born]] on the [[planet]] [[Kooriva]], Denaria Kee was a [[Koorivar]] [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Separatists" /> who became a high-ranking member of the [[Corporate Alliance]]. She was chosen to act as [[Chief Aide/Canon|Chief Aide]]<ref name="SWFC" /> and personal assistant to the head of the Alliance, fellow Koorivar [[Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente]], as he was unwilling to trust his business dealings and illegal enterprises to a member of any other [[species]].<ref name="Separatists" /> As an [[aide]], Kee was responsible for writing drafts, sending covert messages, and managing Argente's meetings.<ref name="SWTVE" />

During the [[Separatist Crisis]]<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> in which former [[Jedi]] [[Count]] [[Dooku]] led a faction seeking to break away from the [[Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Separatists" /> Argente and Kee attended a [[Geonosian accord|secret summit]] led by Dooku<ref name="AotC" /> in the [[Stalgasin hive]] on the planet [[Geonosis]].<ref name="Separatists" /> Kee stood near the [[Techno Union]] [[Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor]] during the summit as the various corporate leaders in attendance pledged their loyalty to Dooku.<ref name="AotC" /> Argente committed the Alliance to Dooku's cause without hesitation, giving up his position as [[senator]] for the Alliance in the Republic's [[Galactic Senate|Senate]].<ref name="Separatists" /> Having learned of the summit from the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had been [[spy]]ing on the meeting, the Republic arrived on Geonosis soon after and [[First Battle of Geonosis|battle]] broke out between the Republic and the Separatists, marking the start of the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="AotC" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|When my new apprentice Darth Vader arrives, he will take care of you.|Darth Sidious tells the Separatist Council to expect Vader's arrival|<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
[[File:TheDeathofDenariaKee.png|thumb|right|300px|Denaria Kee was killed by Darth Vader on Mustafar.]]
During the Clone Wars, Argente served as a member of the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist Council]] and,<ref name="RotS" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> Kee accompanied Argente to the [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility]] on the planet [[Mustafar]] when the council was transferred there from the planet [[Utapau]] during a [[Battle of Utapau|Republic attack]]. She was stood at a console on the walls of the facility's boardroom when [[Darth Sidious]], true leader of the Separatists, contacted the council via [[hologram]] and told them to await the arrival of his [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]].<ref name="RotS" />

Believing everything was going as planned in the war, the council members were caught unprepared when Vader [[Mission to Mustafar|attacked]] them upon his arrival on Mustafar. Having been ordered to wipe out the council by Sidious, Vader [[Death|killed]] everyone in the room, driving his [[Skywalker lightsaber|lightsaber]] through Kee's chest shortly before he cut down Argente.<ref name="RotS" />

==Personality and traits==
Denaria Kee had [[Color|green]] [[eye]]s and purple skin, with the lower half of her face having become a lighter shade of purple<ref name="SWTVE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> by the [[time]] of her death.<ref name="RotS" /> She stood 1.8 [[meter]]s (5 [[Foot|feet]], nine inches) tall.<ref name="Separatists" />

==Equipment==
Denaria Kee wore traditional Koorivar [[clothing]],<ref name="Separatists" /> donning a lilac<ref name="AotC" /> matron's hood<ref name="Separatists" /> with a set of lilac and dark purple<ref name="AotC" /> [[shimmerbird tongue robe]]s<ref name="Separatists" /> for the summit on Geonosis.<ref name="AotC" /> While on Mustafar,<ref name="RotS" /> she wore a dark red outfit that complemented Argente's appearance.<ref name="Separatists" />

==Behind the scenes==
Denaria Kee was portrayed by [[John McEvoy]]<ref name="Actor">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2002/12/imageattack20021213.html|series=Image Attack|text=Alliance Leadership}}</ref> during the character's first appearance in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AotC" /> The character's death scene in the [[2005]] sequel, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], was filmed on Stage 7 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[September 8]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>

According to early set photos and reference sheets for ''Attack of the Clones'', Kee was known during production as "Twink Kee," a pun on the popular twinkie pastry.<ref name="Explanation">[[StarWars.com]] originally appeared in set photos available on site. All relevant data has since been removed.</ref>
